name: File card
prompt: Build one self-contained HTML file for a file or document card. Show a file-type badge (PDF, DOC, or Sheet) made with CSS, file name, owner name, last-modified time, file size, a small progress or sync indicator, and actions such as Open and Share. Style everything in a <style> tag and use light JavaScript only to hide the card on a remove action or toggle a selected state. It should feel like a cloud-drive list item: clean, slightly elevated, and usable in a sidebar or grid. Save it as file-card.html in this folder.

name: Boarding pass
prompt: Build one HTML file for a travel boarding-pass card. Include airline or carrier initials in a badge, passenger name, origin and destination city codes with a connecting line or plane mark made in CSS/SVG, gate and seat, departure time, and a barcode-style stripe at the bottom made with CSS. All styles stay in the file; JavaScript is optional. It should feel like a phone wallet pass: compact, high-contrast, and printable-looking without any extra files. Save it as boarding-pass.html in this folder.

name: Social post
prompt: Make one HTML file that displays a social feed post. Include an author avatar and name, a timestamp, two or three lines of post text, a media placeholder block, and a row of like, comment, and share counts with tappable icons. Style it with CSS in the same file and use light JavaScript so Like can toggle on and update the count. No frameworks, no extra assets. Design it like a modern app feed item that stays readable on desktop and phone. Save it as social-post.html in this folder. make it work and 100% funcitonal. like a live preview

name: Media player
prompt: Create a self-contained HTML file for a compact media player card. Show album art as a colored block or CSS shape, track title, artist name, a progress bar, and play, skip, and like buttons. Use only HTML, CSS, and a small amount of JavaScript to toggle play state and move the progress bar. The file must work when opened locally with no audio file required. Keep the look clean and app-like so it could live in a sidebar or mobile sheet. Save it as media-player.html in this folder.

name: Notification card
prompt: Write a self-contained HTML file for an in-app notification card. Show an app icon or colored badge, a title, two lines of body text, a timestamp, and two small actions such as Dismiss and View. Style it with CSS in the same file and add light JavaScript only if a close button needs to hide the card. It should look like a modern product toast or inbox item and stay readable on a phone. No external libraries or extra files. Save it as notification.html in this folder.

name: Pricing page
prompt: Build one self-contained HTML file for a pricing page with three plans (Starter, Team and Business), a monthly or yearly switch that changes the prices, the features each plan has, and one plan marked as the most popular. Use light JavaScript only for the switch. It should read clearly on desktop and phone. Save it as pricing-page.html in this folder.

name: Slide deck
prompt: Make a slide deck as one HTML file about our third quarter: a title slide, revenue up 18% with a small bar chart of the three months (412, 451 and 487 thousand), what drove it (two new stores and online orders), and next quarter's plan (open the third store in November). The arrow keys move between slides. Save it as slide-deck.html in this folder.

name: Flow diagram
prompt: Draw a flowchart as one HTML file of how an online order is paid: the customer places the order, the shop sends it to payments, payments asks the bank, and the bank answers approved or declined; approved goes on to shipping, declined goes back to the customer with a retry. Save it as flow-diagram.html in this folder.
